sources.description: Standalone full painted rectangle. Exact156x210 source and nearest4 actually viewed with mascot reference. Clearly visible very short dark/grey buzz-cut hair over crown and temples, not bald; brows partly behind round dark-brown tinted spectacles, restrained single near-closed mouth. Faint grey upper-lip area does not securely separate very fine hair from skin shadow; no distinct full beard is readable and do not invent one. Slight screen-left three-quarter head/gaze. Olive-brown notched suit jacket, pale cream pointed shirt and plain dark-brown tie; bust cropped lower/sides with whole hair visible. Soft upper-left light and complete dark-grey painted gradient backing with no card, frame, note or handwriting. Alpha252..255 measured near-opacity, not an exterior cutout. Specific limits under visible-source-differences-v1: individual buzz strands, tinted lens detail and fine upper-lip shading are unreadable; preserve clear short crown/side hair and visible accessory groups.

Standalone full painted rectangle. Exact156x210 original and nearest4 actually viewed with mascot reference. Short combed side-parted brown-black hair with slight wave and grey highlights, dark brows, clearly visible dark compact moustache above single restrained near-closed mouth. Faint jaw stubble/shadow is not a distinct full beard. Three-quarter head and eyes toward screen-left, no hat or glasses. Blue-grey notched suit over cream pointed shirt and plain dark-brown tie; chest/bust crop, whole hairstyle in frame. Soft upper-left illumination and complete dark-grey gradient painted backdrop; no photo card/frame/notes or outside cutout. Measured alpha252..255 is near-opaque source variation, not missing backing. Individual moustache strands, jaw shadow/stubble boundary and fabric weave cannot be exactly proved under visible-source-differences-v1; preserve clear hairstyle/brows/moustache without inventing extra beard.

Standalone full painted rectangle. Exact156x210 original and nearest4 actually viewed with mascot reference. Short brown rolled/waved side hair under a mustard-brown angled fedora; wide white/silver hatband has a clearly visible pointed folded zigzag shape at front, hat crown cropped by top edge. Visible brows and broad joyful single open smile with clearly visible pale upper-teeth band; exact tooth count/individual segmentation is unreadable and not to be invented, but do retain the evident tooth-showing smile. No glasses or facial hair. Near-frontal/slight screen-left head/gaze. Mustard/ochre coat with broad folded collar and one large dark round silver-rimmed button low at center; shoulders/bust cropped lower/sides. Soft upper-left light, complete dark-grey painted rectangle, no card/frame/notes. Alpha252..255 near-opacity is not exterior transparency. Fine hat material/button relief and tooth segmentation are evidence limits under visible-source-differences-v1.

Standalone full painted rectangle. Exact156x210 original and nearest4 actually viewed with mascot reference. Light/mid-brown short waved hair rolled back around crown and nape, fine visible grey-brown brows, no glasses, hat or facial hair. Restrained single closed/near-closed mouth with faint soft smile, near-frontal slightly turned head and mildly raised gaze. Rust-maroon notched outer jacket over dark olive waistcoat and pale cream collared buttoned blouse; bust/shoulders cropped lower/sides, entire hairstyle visible. Soft upper-left facial light and complete dark-grey painted gradient backing, no separate card/frame/note or handwritten mark. Measured alpha249..255 is near-opaque edge variation, not a background/solid-clothing cutout. Fine brow strands, small blouse button detail and weave cannot be exactly resolved at156x210; record those limits without inventing feature matches under visible-source-differences-v1.
